body: Aravind Viswanathan (CFO) on 2025-10-31 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "this change of business has seen an increase in DSO. We do expect normalization over the course of next three to four quarters." Metric: DSO (company). Target: back to ~84 days (pre-increase). Deadline: 2026-09-30. Specificity: vague; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: missed. Evidence: DSO 89 (Q2FY26) -> 91 (Q3) -> ~86 adjusted (Q4) -> 95 (Q1FY27) -> 105 'after normalizing for the delayed remittances' (Q2FY27). Q2FY27: 'a quarterly aberration ... expected to get to double digit levels in Q3'. Explanation given: fixed-price mix; remittance delays at quarter-end
